documents.title: Clarification sought from Advance Agrolife Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Advance Agrolife Limited reported its highest ever quarterly performance for Q1 FY2027, with revenue increasing by 96% year-on-year to 3,304 million and PAT rising 152% to 225.5 million. Management highlighted ongoing expansion plans, including the upcoming Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidani expected by Q3 FY27 and the newly commenced Unit-5 facility at Dahej II. The company aims to increase its export share to 20% of revenue by FY29 and execute a 4x capacity expansion in 2,4-D herbicides to 10,000 MT by Q4 FY28. Furthermore, the company continues to leverage its backward integration strategy and a large library of CIB & RC registrations to drive margin expansion and secure market share. Advance Agrolife Limited reported its financial and operational results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting strong growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its export revenue share from approximately 2% to 20% by FY29.
guidance.quote: We are aggressively targeting an increase in our export revenue share from a negligible 2% today to 20% by FY29.

demand_outlook.claim: Pretilachlor is noted as the premier post-emergence herbicide for Paddy in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Core Application: Pretilachlor is the premier post-emergence herbicide for Paddy (Rice), India’s largest crop by acreage.

demand_outlook.claim: By maintaining a strategic balance between Kharif and Rabi products, the company flattens revenue volatility and ensures consistent cash flow visibility.
demand_outlook.quote: By maintaining a strategic balance between Kharif (Monsoon) and Rabi (Winter) products, the Company effectively flattens the revenue volatility curve typical of the agrochemical sector, ensuring consistent cash flow visibility throughout the fiscal year.

demand_outlook.claim: Pretilachlor is noted as the premier post-emergence herbicide for paddy, ensuring high capacity utilization across Kharif and Rabi seasons.
demand_outlook.quote: Core Application: Pretilachlor is the premier post-emergence herbicide for Paddy (Rice), India’s largest crop by acreage. Critical for the Kharif & Rabi season, ensuring high capacity utilization.

demand_outlook.claim: AAL's Q3 FY26 income increased by 18% year-on-year due to increased demand and new customer additions.
demand_outlook.quote: • AAL’s Q3 FY26 Income at ₹ 1338 million increased by 18% Y-o-Y on the back of increased demand and addition of new customers.

capex_expansion.claim: AAL aims to commence operations at its new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27 with an estimated first-phase capex of approximately 250 million.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ¥ 250 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant to increase renewable energy use and reduce its carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: AAL is in the process of setting up a 3.75 MW solar power plant with the objective of increasing the use of renewable energy and reducing its carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into an MOU to acquire land for setting up Unit-5 at Dahej II GIDC Industrial Estate for manufacturing technical grade pesticides.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has entered into an MOU for acquisition of land admeasuring 17,491.02 sq. mtrs. for setting up a new plant, proposed to be named Unit-5, situated at Dahej II GIDC Industrial Estate, Bharuch, Gujrat for manufacturing of technical grade pesticides.

capex_expansion.claim: AAL set up a new R&D laboratory focused on developing innovative product combinations and strengthening its long-term product pipeline.
capex_expansion.quote: • AAL set up a new R&D laboratory focused on developing innovative product combinations and strengthening our long-term product pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is considering setting up manufacturing facilities for Pretilachlor and PEDA with installed production capacities of about 13 tonnes per day and 10 tonnes per day respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: • The company is considering setting up of manufacturing facilities for Pretilachlor and PEDA, with installed production capacities of about 13 tonnes per day and 10 tonnes per day respectively.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 was steady at 10.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for Q1 were steady at 10.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is noted as the primary driver for margin expansion by capturing margins previously ceded to suppliers.
margins_costs.quote: •Backward Integration (The Margin Engine): This is the primary driver for the margin expansion. By transitioning from buying technicals to manufacturing them in-house we capture the margin previously ceded to suppliers and benefit from significant operating leverage as utilisation rates improve.
